description: The PB-45 RTO serves the Talwandi Sabo sub-division in the Bathinda district of Punjab. It operates as an SDM-level registering authority responsible for vehicle registrations and driving license issuance. The office plays a vital role in managing transport regulations for this significant agricultural and religious center.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Talwandi Sabo, District Bathinda, Punjab
